subject.title: Discord DMs: inbound messages silently dropped (outbound works)

question: Should Discord account-scoped allowFrom remain a restrictive override of root allowFrom, or should root and account allowlists be unioned for inbound DM admission?
rationale: The source-proven repair path changes who is authorized to start Discord DM agent sessions, and the current docs/tests intentionally preserve account-scoped override semantics.

options.title: Preserve restrictive overrides
options.body: Keep account allowFrom as a security boundary and fix the user problem through explicit DM ownership, diagnostics, or documented configuration guidance.

options.title: Union root and account allowlists
options.body: Merge root and account allowFrom entries so global users are always accepted, accepting that existing restrictive account configs may become broader.

options.title: Defer until live proof
options.body: Wait for a live multi-account DM reproduction before choosing an authorization contract or reopening a repair branch.

recommendation.title: Preserve restrictive overrides
recommendation.body: Keep account allowFrom as a security boundary and fix the user problem through explicit DM ownership, diagnostics, or documented configuration guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared DM access and account-resolution history makes this the strongest routing candidate for the security-boundary decision.
